data.message: I reaffirm 18. At 200 next month, I support 2 each, not 3: leaving 100 gives next stock 200 or 1,000. To those favoring 10–16: 18 pays $8,000 more than 10 now, but risks a lean month (25%); future compliance isn't enforced. Unanimity is not yet reached. Will each holdout explicitly accept 18 plus this low-stock plan?
